sources.note: Air New Zealand's Auckland page publishes exact-code nonstop inbound routes from WLG, CHC, ZQN, DUD and IVC and also identifies current inbound international nonstop service. These directions are used independently rather than inferred from outbound services.

Current Air New Zealand Pacific page lists nonstop Auckland routes to Rarotonga, Nadi, Niue, Apia, Nuku'alofa, Noumea and Papeete, plus seasonal Christchurch-Rarotonga. Route-only evidence does not become a dated timetable.

Air India official international connectivity map says it flies nonstop to 41 destinations and draws bidirectional arrows between each listed overseas airport and the named Indian airport(s). It is a broad route-universe snapshot, not a current dated timetable; later current advisories and route launches override it where applicable.

Current Air India homepage advisory states all Air India flights to all Middle East destinations are suspended. Middle East pairs shown on the February route map are therefore not inserted as current positive route evidence in this round.

AEGEAN's current flight-status board exposes exact airport pairs and distinguishes rows labeled Aegean Airlines from OlympicAir. GCMP retains only directions explicitly shown as Aegean Airlines on the reviewed current board; OA rows are excluded and no reverse direction is inferred unless separately shown.

Royal Jordanian's Quick Reference Timetable No.473 is explicitly valid 01Sep-30Sep 2026 and publishes exact airport codes, directional flight identities and special From/To AQJ/ADJ rows. Its legend marks one-stop services with * and RO/GF/WY-operated codeshare aircraft with #; the reviewed September flight rows contain no # marker and YYZ is the only * one-stop city row. GCMP retains only exact direct legs that can be represented without decomposing the YYZ through service.

ODbL ADSBiq aircraft-diff observations from 2026-08-01 through 2026-09-06, using the public 2026-08 and 2026-09 release assets. Only exact active-alliance callsigns observed during this recent window are considered; observation alone does not provide an airport pair. Missing upstream daily assets: 2026-08-30.
CC0 standing-data exact callsign-to-route mapping. A route is retained only when the exact callsign was actually observed in the Aug 1-Sep 6 ADSBiq window.
Public search-index sitemap additionally confirms each retained physical pair remains in the current scheduled-passenger route index (65,052 directional pairs).

2026-Q2 worldwide ADS-B-derived passenger-flight observations. GCMP retains only callsign-validated directional routes with at least two known non-cargo passenger-config observations; this is recent-operation evidence, not a September timetable.

CC0 Virtual Radar Server standing-data callsign-to-route mapping at the pinned commit. Used only to corroborate the observed carrier/route identity; standing-data alone is not treated as an active timetable.

Public search-index route sitemap confirmed that each retained physical airport pair remained present in the current scheduled-passenger route index (65,052 indexed directional pairs). It does not establish the operating carrier by itself.
ODbL ADSBiq observations from 2026-08-01 through 2026-09-06 for explicitly source-backed regional/affiliate operator ICAO prefixes. Missing upstream daily assets: 2026-08-30.
CC0 exact callsign-to-route lookup used only for affiliate callsigns actually observed in the ADSBiq window.
Public route sitemap additionally confirms each retained physical pair remains in the current scheduled-passenger index (65,052 directional pairs).
BA CityFlyer: British Airways identifies BA CityFlyer as a wholly-owned subsidiary operating UK domestic and European services from London City.
BA Euroflyer: British Airways identifies BA Euroflyer as a wholly-owned subsidiary operating services from London Gatwick.
Iberia Express: Iberia states that Iberia, Iberia Express and Iberia Regional Air Nostrum jointly fly the Iberia network from Madrid.
Iberia Regional Air Nostrum: Iberia publishes dedicated guidance for flights operated by Iberia Regional Air Nostrum and applies Iberia baggage conditions.

QantasLink: Qantas conditions apply to QF-designated Australian flights operated by National Jet Systems, Sunstate or Eastern Australia; current QantasLink operations use the QLK callsign for these services.
Alliance Airlines: Qantas conditions explicitly include QF-designated Australian flights operated by Alliance Airlines.
Jazz Aviation: Air Canada says Jazz Aviation operates flights on its behalf under the Air Canada Express brand.

U.S. DOT BTS June 2026 Marketing Carrier On-Time Performance. Routes are attributed by IATA marketing carrier, so branded regional/code-share operations are assigned to AA/AS/DL/UA rather than inferred from the regional operating carrier.
Public search-index sitemap corroborates that each retained June marketing-carrier physical pair remains in the current scheduled-passenger route index (65,052 directional pairs).
CC0 callsign-to-route dictionary used as a high-recall carrier attribution candidate. A standing row can outlive active service, so it is never operating-carrier proof by itself.
Each retained physical airport pair is still present in the public current scheduled-passenger route sitemap (65,052 directional pairs). This confirms the pair, not the listed carrier identity.
